correctness.rationale: For p>=5, f_p(pt)=p^2(-t+p^(p-2)t^p) has bijective inner map by Hensel. On each unit ball x=zeta+pt, the critical derivative vanishes and expansion yields (1-p)zeta+p^3 u_zeta t^2 U(t), with U(t) in 1+pZ_p[[t]]; t sqrt(U(t)) is a p-adic bijection, giving disjoint square cylinders. Counting p^m quadratic residues by valuations gives S_p(m) and image density. At p=3, explicit cubic t^2(t+/-1) on the two unit balls has two full residue-output classes each, yielding exactly 13 classes mod81 and all higher lifts. Independent direct value-set enumeration for 20 prime/exponent levels matches formulas and the ternary T list. C holds for all odd p by the analytic Hensel argument, not by finite enumeration.
